nodes.description: The variant proteins reach the cytoplasm and still dimerize with wild-type WDR37. The N-terminal variants are expressed at levels similar to wild type, while the C-terminal variants are expressed at lower levels. Two human variants fail to rescue the Drosophila wdr37 null, so they impair function. In zebrafish, heterozygous missense alleles were lethal to larvae while heterozygous frameshift alleles were not, which suggested a dominant negative effect. Whether that is the mechanism in patients is open (see the discussion on variant mechanism). The only molecular activities shown for WDR37 are homodimerization and binding to PACS1 and PACS2; the homodimerization term is bound without a modifier because variant proteins still dimerize with wild type, so it names the activity, not a defect in it.

nodes.description: Hypothesis node. WDR37's main binding partners are the phosphofurin acidic cluster sorting proteins PACS1 and PACS2, and WDR37 and PACS1 depend on each other for stable expression in cultured cells and in C. elegans. Of the seven WDR37 variants tested for binding, only p.Asp220Gly lost binding to PACS1 and PACS2. So the shared biology of the three disorders points at this complex, but no study has shown that a NOCGUS variant impairs complex function.

nodes.description: The initiating lesion is a heterozygous WDR37 variant, arising de novo in every individual reported with a pathogenic or likely pathogenic call. The founding missense variants (p.Thr115Ile, p.Ser119Phe, p.Ser119Tyr, p.Thr125Ile, p.Ser129Cys, p.Thr130Ile) cluster upstream of the first WD40 repeat. A second cluster lies in or just after the second WD40 repeat (p.Asp220Gly and p.Asp260Asn de novo; p.Pro257His inherited from an unaffected mother and of uncertain significance). One de novo intronic deletion (c.727-27_727-24del) causes retention of 63 intronic bases and an in-frame insertion of 21 amino acids. No truncating variant has been reported as causal.

meta.association: Heterozygous de novo WDR37 variants: missense changes in an N-terminal cluster upstream of the first WD40 repeat (p.Thr115 to p.Thr130), missense changes in a second cluster in and between WD40 repeats 2 and 3, and one in-frame splice variant.
